R6I-grouse-walk-0003.name: 790 m E of Thautil River
R6I-grouse-walk-0003.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R6I-grouse-walk-0003.parkWhat: pull off on Chisholm FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
4 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
2 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Route enters a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Telkwa Mountains. Closed Year Round. Synopsis map 1-110/23.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from City of Terrace, about 107 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 54.28449, -127.34653, pull off on Chisholm FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: the Road stretch, 5.7 km one way. About 113 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip). Also: black bear (see evidence).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-9, Region 6. Season: grouse Sept 10 to Nov 15 and more rows (synopsis page 51, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.
R6I-grouse-walk-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-9: about 10,278 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.72 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
